title: Business Analyst II
description:
**Role Purpose**


The AI Business Analyst will identify, assess, and champion opportunities to apply AI and automation across internal business functions. This role bridges the gap between business needs and AI capability — working closely with stakeholders across departments to understand pain points, map processes, and build the case for where AI/automation can drive efficiency, cost savings, or improved employee experience, then supporting adoption once solutions are approved.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with department leads and teams across the business (Finance, HR, Operations, IT, Customer Service, etc.) to identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient processes that could benefit from AI or automation.
* Conduct process mapping and requirements\-gathering workshops to document current\-state workflows and pain points.
* Assess and prioritize AI/automation opportunities based on feasibility, business impact, cost, and effort, building business cases to support investment decisions.
* Research and evaluate available AI tools, platforms, and use cases (internal and external) relevant to identified opportunities.
* Work with IT/Engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications for AI/automation solutions.
* Support pilot programs and proof\-of\-concepts for new AI use cases, tracking outcomes and measuring impact against defined success metrics.
* Develop training materials, guides, and change management plans to support internal adoption of new AI tools and workflows.
* Track and report on AI/automation adoption metrics across the organization, highlighting wins, blockers, and areas for further investment.
* Stay current on AI/automation trends and best practices, bringing relevant ideas back into the business.
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams throughout the solution lifecycle, from ideation through rollout and adoption.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Process Improvement, or Business Transformation role.
* Demonstrated experience identifying and scoping automation or process improvement initiatives (RPA, workflow automation, AI\-driven tools, or similar).
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with teams across all levels of the business.
* Experience with process mapping and documentation tools/methods (e.g. Lucidchart).
* Analytical mindset with the ability to build business cases, including cost\-benefit and ROI analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain AI/automation concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with IT/technical teams to translate business needs into requirements.
* Familiarity with common AI tools and use cases (e.g., generative AI assistants, RPA platforms, workflow automation tools) and how they apply to business operations.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Direct experience working with generative AI platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) in a business setting.
* Experience with change management frameworks and driving user adoption of new tools/technology.
* Exposure to RPA tools (UiPath, Power Automate, Automation Anywhere) or low\-code/no\-code platforms.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

At MRI, one of our core values is to *strive to amaze.* From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

* Experience leading functional activities through requirements, design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post\-go\-live support.
* Experience troubleshooting complex SAP functional and integration issues and performing root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with at least one full\-cycle SAP implementation, major rollout, or transformation program.
* Experience with data migration, interfaces, reporting, and integration technologies such as IDocs, file transfers, web services, and APIs.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to facilitate requirements, solution design, and problem\-solving discussions with business and technical teams.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to independently manage complex functional assignments, priorities, and deliverables.
* Ability to build consensus and work effectively across functions, business units, and global teams.
* Strong documentation, organizational, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar application lifecycle and service management tools.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, or transformation programs.
* Experience working with global SAP templates and global Finance processes.
